## 

```{r}
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.textstats)

# 1. Load a built-in corpus
corp <- data_corpus_inaugural

# 2. Inspect documents and their metadata
ndoc(corp)
head(docnames(corp))
head(docvars(corp))

# 3. Select speeches from 1981 onward
corp_recent <- corpus_subset(corp, Year >= 1981)

# 4. Split the documents into words
# Keep this version for examining words in context
toks_context <- tokens(
  corp_recent,
  remove_punct = TRUE
)

# 5. See how "freedom" is used
kwic(toks_context, pattern = "freedom", window = 5)

# 6. Prepare a version for word-frequency analysis
toks_clean <- tokens_tolower(toks_context)

toks_clean <- tokens_remove(
  toks_clean,
  pattern = stopwords("en")
)

# 7. Create a document-feature matrix
dfmat <- dfm(toks_clean)

# Number of documents and word features
ndoc(dfmat)
nfeat(dfmat)

# 8. Most frequent words across the corpus
topfeatures(dfmat, 20)

# 9. A more detailed frequency table
freq <- textstat_frequency(dfmat, n = 20)
print(freq)

# 10. Compare relative word frequencies
dfmat_prop <- dfm_weight(dfmat, scheme = "prop")

# Display a small part of the matrix
as.matrix(dfmat_prop[1:5, 1:10])
```
